title: マイルCSの後に・トラストミー！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle scores a magnificent victory, eliciting celebratory cheers and thunderous applause from the stands!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: By defeating the mighty Silence Suzuka and scoring victories in three G1 sprints, Taiki has undoubtedly demonstrated her star potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After dominating all of her races, she only has one goal remaining—becoming the next Umamusume of the Year!
